items.title: Judge denies Lindsay Clancy’s motion to dismiss case, paving the way for potential retrial
items.brief: A judge in Massachusetts denied Lindsay Clancy’s motion to dismiss her murder case, clearing the way for her to face a second trial for allegedly killing her three children.

items.title: Ohio State fraternity placed on interim suspension after video shows two people on fire
items.brief: An Ohio State fraternity has been temporarily suspended after a widely circulated video captured two people whose clothes were engulfed in fire, surrounded by a crowd of onlookers in university jerseys.

items.title: Nvidia stock falls after investigation into CEO, bucking market rally
items.brief: Wall Street rallied sharply on Monday, despite a 4% decline in Nvidia shares, as markets continued to rebound from last week’s sharp sell-off .

items.title: Trump isn’t done alienating his base — this time on ‘amnesty’
items.brief: It remains unlikely that President Donald Trump would ever sign off on giving millions of undocumented immigrants a path to legal status.

items.title: A record number of women will serve in the next Congress
items.brief: After this year’s historic blue wave, more women than ever before are set to serve in the next Congress.

items.title: Gunman who killed at least 6 in Kraków mass shooting dies in hospital
items.brief: A gunman who killed at least six people during a deadly rampage in the Polish city of Kraków on Saturday has died in a hospital, police said Monday.
